mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit demand (RSAFS) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals financial tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as spending weakens.
failure_condition: Negative return pattern fails in >55% of simultaneous RSAFS decline and FEDFUNDS rise instances, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.5 indicates manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO <100.5 instances during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth trend supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS growth instances, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400 thousand units signals residential sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic slowdown accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of HOUST <1400 instances, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rise signals dual monetary-labor shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic stress intensifies.
failure_condition: Negative return pattern fails in >55% of simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE rise instances, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Post-inflation peak disinflation (CPIAUCSL <3.0%) signals Fed policy pivot toward easing, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as risk appetite improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of CPIAUCSL <3.0% instances during post-inflation peak regime, or Rank IC over 3 years <0.02.
